message:
Dawesville Weekend Assessment

Friday stays dry but overcast at 19 degrees, before light showers arrive on Saturday (20) and Sunday (18) under gentle winds. Pirates of Penzance plays ManPAC all weekend, and Sunday brings Pinjarra Garden Day at Edenvale plus the Mandjar Markets. With crabbing closed until December, the blue swimmers get another weekend off, so pack an umbrella and admire someone else's roses ☂️
Dawesville weekend: 5/10
